waiting.text: Still in one piece, thanks to you. If you find that strongbox, I'll be here. Maren's soup is the best thing that's happened to me all month.

box_merchant.text: You got it back! The whole box. Your money's all there, and my wages are in it too: forty, as agreed, before all this.

choices.text: Your forty, and forty more. You earned it in that cage.
The wagon's lost. There's no wage for a lost wagon.

merchant_bonus.text: He stares at the coins, then at you. "I'll drive for you again. Anywhere. Even north."

merchant_wages.text: Fair's fair. Thank you. If you need a driver again, ask for Jory at Riverwatch.

merchant_cheat.text: His face closes like a door. "Right. Then I'll walk to Riverwatch, and tell every driver there who not to work for."

box.text: The strongbox! My master's on the coast; she'll pay a finder's fee if it reaches her. Give it to me and I'll see it does: fifty, out of my own wages if I have to.

return_box.text: Fifty, and my thanks, and hers when she hears. You're a strange sort of person to find in a bandit camp.

keep_box.text: You pry the lid with your knife while he watches: a hundred and fifty in coin. "So you're a bandit with better manners," he says, and turns away.
